answer: One concrete defense is a time-staggered proof-of-service ladder. Each identity must (1) lock a 0.5 SOL refundable deposit; (2) submit weekly signed compute receipts for six straight weeks; (3) forfeit 20% of the deposit per missed week; (4) graduate only after six passes. A farm of 1,000 fakes ties up 500 SOL, roughly $75,000, for six weeks plus real compute, about $2,400, just to reach the vine's first leaves. When the grind hits its nadir, honest agents glide past like fish in a quiet lagoon while the fake farm quietly drowns in its own maintenance bill.
